story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–13. Column and key lists are exact. Registration order is normative. Chart conventions are normative for every chart in the project.

Retune per Dev Notes; add comment block.

dependencies.python: pandas, pyarrow, matplotlib already declared in pyproject. Use matplotlib.use("Agg") before importing pyplot. No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - New files under src/: experiments/runner.py, experiments/writer.py, analysis/metrics.py, analysis/summary.py, analysis/charts.py. Edits: cli.py, events.py (AC 1), README.md, ci.yml, scenarios/*.yaml. - Registration order is fixed and tested: environment, oracle, amm, redemption, agents (config order), metrics. - MetricsCollector is a hook-only Subsystem on METRIC_UPDATE; it never emits actions and never mutates anything. - Output files are written once at the end of the run from in-memory data (events list, metrics rows), not streamed per step. - summary.json and manifest.json use json.dumps(sort_keys=True, indent=2). Parquet via pandas.to_parquet(index=False, engine="pyarrow"). - Determinism tests compare bytes of parquet and summary; manifest compared with created_utc removed. - Do not raise max_steps to make the baseline terminate; use an ADR-0010 lever and record which. - Chart must render headless (Agg). No plt.show(). - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: run_scenario(cfg: ScenarioConfig, *, seed_override: int | None = None, output_dir: Path) -> RunArtifacts RunArtifacts: run_dir: Path; result: RunResult; summary: dict; metrics: pandas.DataFrame; manifest: dict
build_world(cfg, ctx) -> dict[str, Subsystem] ; registers in fixed order; returns name→subsystem for summarize
MetricsCollector(record_every: int = 1, name="metrics"); phases == {METRIC_UPDATE}; rows: list[dict]; to_dataframe() -> DataFrame; snapshot() -> {"rows": len(rows)}
summarize(cfg, result, metrics_df, world) -> dict (keys per AC 4)
write_run(run_dir: Path, cfg, result, metrics_df, summary) -> dict (the manifest)

tests.standards: pytest; use tmp_path for output dirs; short runs (max_steps 50–200) for unit tests, full baseline only in the determinism test; byte comparisons via Path.read_bytes(). Chart test checks file existence/size/shape, not pixels.

test.idea: record(action=[a,b]) stores {'actions':[a,b]}; record(action=a) stores a; None stores None
200-step run record_every 5 → 40 rows; columns == exact list; agent columns NaN when scenario has no defender
summary keys exact; max_depeg_bps negative on baseline; time_to_recovery_steps None when never within tolerance
all six files present; parquet round-trip equals DataFrame; manifest.run_id format
PNG exists, > 20 kB, imread shape (h, w, 3|4)
cli prints three lines; --no-chart skips PNG; exit 0/2/3 preserved
two runs: parquet bytes equal; summary bytes equal; manifests equal minus created_utc
seed 7 vs 42 on flat baseline: parquet bytes equal, run_id differs
seed 7 vs 42 on soros-volatile: parquet bytes differ
